Nigel Morse has many years of experience in offering driving lessons to people of all ages throughout Cirencester and the surrounding areas.
He provides lessons for beginners all the way through to those who are looking to achieve their pass plus.
Available when you book 10 driving lessons upfront.

12 Blake Road, Cirencester, Gloucestershire, GL7 266 | 07793 200128
Cookie Preferences | Website By Athena Web Designs
Start your journey to passing your driving test with Nigel Morse Driving School.

Nigel will tailor your driving lessons around your individual requirements, whether you are a beginner or a more experienced learner looking to make the final preparations before booking that all important test.
You will learn to drive in Nigel's dual-controlled Vauxhall Corsa, which is an ideal car for learners.
£20 discount! This offer is available to those who block book 10 lessons.
Nigel also offers refresher driving lessons for those that have passed their test and perhaps have not driven for a long period of time.

The Pass Plus is offered to those that have passed their driving test but would like some additional lessons driving at night, on dual carriageways/ motorways, on rural roads, in towns and in extreme weather conditions. There is no test as such, instead you are assessed throughout your lessons. After passing your Pass Plus you may even be able to save money on your car insurance.
Daytime lessons available early till 5.30pm Monday through to Friday.
If you would like to make a booking please contact Nigel on 07793 200128.
If you would like more information or to book a lesson with Nigel please contact him using the following details:
Email: info@nigelmorsedrivingschool.co.uk
Alternatively, please fill in the form on the right-hand side and Nigel will get back to you as soon as possible.
Please take a look at the following websites for further advice and information on passing your driving test:
Safe Driving for Life - Practice theory tests
Safe Driving for Life - Stopping Distances Game
TSO Shop - The official Driving Standards Agency shop
To find out about more please contact Nigel on the above telephone number or email address.
